  <p>Hello, I'm Seokju Kang. I am currently a Ph.D. student in Management Engineering at UNIST, supervised by Prof. Hyun Jin Jang. Prior to that, I completed my B.S. in Industrial Engineering at Pusan Nat'l University.</p>

  <p>My research domain is in <strong>Financial Engineering</strong>, with particular emphasis on risk management, derivatives pricing, and quantitative methods in finance. I am also working on <strong>AI/OR applications in finance</strong>. For further details, please visit <a href="research/">the list of my papers and projects</a>.</p>
